description: This file declares the ClientSocketPoolManager class and related functions for managing socket pools in the Chromium networking code. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and external references related to socket pool management.

classes.name: ClientSocketPoolManager
classes.description: Manages access to all ClientSocketPools, handling their lifetime and destruction order.

methods.name: ClientSocketPoolManager
methods.description: Constructor for the socket pool manager.

methods.name: ~ClientSocketPoolManager
methods.description: Destructor for the socket pool manager.

methods.name: FlushSocketPoolsWithError
methods.description: Flushes all socket pools with a specified error code.

methods.name: GetSocketPool
methods.description: Returns the socket pool for a given proxy server.

methods.name: SocketPoolInfoToValue
methods.description: Creates a value summary of socket pool states.
